cache_state: paired pre-release pure Parent and real Current append768 states with rolling eviction
candidate_rule: 8 most recent unique known items; remaining uniform known catalog without replacement; SeedSequence([17,uid]); no feedback labels
history_tie_order: timestamp_mapped_item_behavior, aligned Parent and Current Full histories
teacher: Full/native logits computed once per actual scene terminal and reused across epochs and validation
fitting: 8 mixed-only joint logit epochs; only one native-residual scalar per layer is trained; original Parent mapping fixed
normalization: original Round11 network and all normalization buffers frozen; one pure-fit logit RMS
validation_rule: fixed endpoint; separate validation users report response and Full-logit error only, with no checkpoint selection
kv_supervision: warm start from response-distilled Item-KV64; refinement uses only final Full logits, no token-KV loss
checkpoint_verification: sealed manifest and seal bindings checked; large payload hashes inherited

settings.initialization: exact initial-calibration checkpoint; no random reinitialization
settings.gradient_weighting: each equal-length batch loss multiplied by batch_users/configured_batch_size

cost.scope: initial calibration charged once plus every new source/teacher capture, Full/native target score, complete differentiable query path, all optimizer steps and train/held-out diagnostics; both scene captures/native replay/context and actual terminal teachers, both target sets and pure/mixed diagnostics; one scene per UID per epoch
cost.convention: multiply-add=2; complete query forward includes native reads, mapped KV and additional mapped reads; joint forward+backward conservatively3x complete forward including frozen foundation projections; AdamW+gradient clip estimated18 operations/parameter/step

item_feature_source.scope: each scene actual terminal item IDs; one lookup per scene, reused across all layers

settings.initialization: one global torch.manual_seed(17) before constructing all layers

scene_protocol.training_rule: every epoch a768 only; pure scenes supply the fixed RMS and diagnostics
